title: Elevation
summary: Height of the land surface at about 30 m resolution, used for slope and elevation at candidate sites.
method: Clipped from Earth Engine to the pilot bounding box plus 0.05 degrees and stored as a 16-bit GeoTIFF (no-data -9999).
limitations: A surface model that includes trees and buildings, not bare earth.
Vertical error is large in flat floodplains, so it is not suitable for flood-depth estimates.
